summary: Iteration 2 frontend testing (localStorage app). Tested all NEW features: blue navy sidebar, Settings page with logo upload/shop-name/WA-template edit + persistence, WA placeholder rendering, payments add/remove with balance recompute, Invoice A4 + Thermal (58mm) with QR code, print button, back navigation, and role-based restrictions for kasir & teknisi. 15/15 new-feature checks passed. No blocking issues.

ui_bugs.issue: Sidebar does not reactively update to reflect saved shop_name / logo until a route change occurs. The Settings save dispatches a 'storage' event but Sidebar doesn't subscribe. Users have to click a nav item to see updated header. Minor UX issue.

issues: React hydration console warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' - originates from Emergent ve-dynamic wrappers injected around dynamic option text (RepairDetail add-part-select). Non-blocking noise in dev console.

action_items: (Optional/low) Make Sidebar listen to a settings-changed event or window 'storage' event so shop name/logo update immediately after Save in Settings without requiring navigation.
critical_code_review_comments: settingsApi.get() reads localStorage synchronously on every render but Sidebar has no dependency causing re-render post-save; consider a lightweight settings context or subscription.
seed_data_creation: Used seeded admin/kasir/teknisi accounts and existing seeded repair KK-2501-006. Uploaded a 1x1 test PNG as logo. Modified shop_name to 'Bengkel Test' and simplified WA template.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration-2 new features verified. Key testids used: nav-settings, setting-shop-name, setting-wa-template, btn-upload-logo, logo-file-input, logo-preview, btn-save-settings, btn-open-invoice, invoice-page, invoice-a4, invoice-thermal, mode-a4, mode-thermal, btn-print-now, btn-back-invoice, pay-amount, pay-method, pay-note, btn-add-payment, payment-row-*, btn-remove-payment-*, payments-sum, btn-wa-send. Login page uses login-username/login-password/login-submit (NOT username-input/password-input as agent-to-agent context suggested). Sidebar bg computed = rgb(9,35,93) navy blue. Role restrictions verified: kasir & teknisi redirected from /settings and /users to /dashboard. Kasir can add payments; teknisi sees payments-section (history) but NOT btn-add-payment. WA link correctly renders placeholders (Rina Marlina, KK-2501-006).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no functional defects found. Only a minor reactive-update UX gap in Sidebar after settings save.
